notes.title: Demo bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone that played the Emergent Fates Re:Developed Demo during Steam Next Fest!

Based on some very helpful feedback from ghostyamato I've made a few bug fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where forging some augments would result in Eager Spirit instead of the expected augment
[*] Fixed bug where party's HP/AP would not be recovered after loading auto-save
[*] Changed how loot drops are calculated which should result in significantly more drops (this includes essences)
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the changes.
